# Hi, I'm Farshad Tofighi

**Applied AI & Machine Learning Engineer | Python, LLMs, AI Automation | UI Developer**

I build practical AI systems end to end. My work runs from data exploration and model development to LLM-powered applications, backend services and APIs, automated workflows, and clean, responsive user interfaces.

## 💫 About Me

I came to AI from geoscience. I hold a degree in **Petroleum Engineering (Oil Exploration)** from **Imam Khomeini International University (IKIU)**. My research there used artificial intelligence and 3D seismic attributes to estimate reservoir porosity. That work taught me how to turn noisy, complex real-world data into reliable models people can base decisions on, and I bring the same approach to every project.

Today I work across **machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision**. I like taking a problem from raw data to a working solution: cleaning and analyzing data, building and evaluating models, explaining their behavior, and fitting them into real workflows.

To put models into production, I build **backend services and REST APIs** with **FastAPI**, **Django**, and **Django REST Framework**. That covers serving ML and LLM models through fast, well-documented endpoints, as well as building full Django backends with data models, authentication, and business logic.

I also design **AI-driven automation workflows** with **Python and n8n**. These workflows connect LLMs, APIs, and business tools so repetitive processes can run on their own.

My **front-end development** skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) let me build responsive, visually engaging interfaces with modern animations. Together with my backend skills, this means I can deliver the whole product: the model, the API that serves it, and the interface people use.

I also teach **Python programming and artificial intelligence** at the Shahriar branch of the Technical and Vocational Training Organization (TVTO) in Tehran. There I help learners move from fundamentals to hands-on AI projects.

## 📊 Featured Projects

### LLMs & AI Automation

**[Describe Image in Persian](https://github.com/farshad257/Describe_Image_in_Persian)** · [Live Demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Farshad257/Describe_Image_in_Persian)
Upload an image and get a Persian-language AI description, with optional speech output. Built on GPT-4o vision and a Gradio interface, and deployed as a Hugging Face Space.
`Python` `GPT-4o` `Gradio` `Multimodal AI` `TTS`

**[TTS Workflow](https://github.com/farshad257/TTS_Workflow)**
An AI-powered text-to-speech automation workflow built on an OpenAI-compatible API, with a Gradio front end for easy use.
`Python` `Gradio` `OpenAI API` `Automation`

### Deep Learning & Computer Vision

**[Facial Emotion Recognition (FER-2013)](https://github.com/farshad257/CNN_FER-2013)**
A 5-layer CNN that recognizes human emotions from facial images. It uses data augmentation, max pooling, and dropout, and reaches **76% validation / 63% test accuracy** on FER-2013. Useful for human-computer interaction.
`Python` `CNN` `Deep Learning` `Computer Vision`

**[Handwritten Digit Recognition](https://github.com/farshad257/Hand_writing_digits)**
A CNN classifier for handwritten digits, written to PEP 8, clean-code, and SOLID principles. It includes a case study comparing the performance of simple and complex models.
`Python` `CNN` `Clean Code` `Model Comparison`

### Machine Learning & NLP

**[Income Forecasting with Stacked Ensembles](https://github.com/farshad257/Regrassion_Income_Forcasting)**
A stacked ensemble regressor that combines Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, Bagging, Linear Regression, and Decision Trees. It reaches **R² = 0.876**.
`Python` `scikit-learn` `Ensemble Learning` `Regression`

**[Sentiment Analysis on IMDB](https://github.com/farshad257/NLP_IMDB)**
A Bernoulli Naive Bayes model that reaches **94% accuracy** on IMDB movie-review sentiment classification. It shows how far a well-prepared simple model can go.
`Python` `NLP` `Text Classification` `NLTK`

**[Energy Consumption Modeling](https://github.com/farshad257/Energy_Consumption_Modeling)**
Time-series forecasting of energy consumption. The project covers data preparation, feature engineering, outlier detection, and model evaluation.
`Python` `Time Series` `Feature Engineering` `Forecasting`

## 🧑🏻‍💻 What I Work On

- **Applied Machine Learning:** predictive modeling, feature engineering, model evaluation, and explainability
- **Deep Learning:** neural networks for vision and language tasks
- **NLP & LLMs:** text processing, Transformer models, and LLM-based applications
- **Computer Vision:** image analysis and recognition
- **Backend & APIs:** REST APIs and model-serving services with FastAPI, full backends with Django and Django REST Framework
- **AI Automation:** end-to-end workflows that combine LLMs, APIs, and webhooks
- **UI Development:** responsive, animated, user-focused web interfaces
